formal_statement: ∀ (α β γ αΓ βΓ γΓ : Type) (ea : α → List αΓ) (eb : β → List βΓ) (ec : γ → List γΓ) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ), PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime ea eb f → PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime eb ec g → PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime ea ec (fun a : α => g (f a))
plain_statement: If f is computable in polynomial time and g is computable in polynomial time, with the output encoding of f being the input encoding of g, then g after f is computable in polynomial time.
title: Polynomial-time computable functions compose
